newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower, Nissan Mutual impact mild.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower, Nissan Mutual impact mild.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended Friday slightly lower as investors squared positions ahead of the weekend, brokers said.
News that Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co had been ordered to halt its business by the Finance Ministry had a mild impact on the market, they said.
The Nikkei average closed 85.21 points or 0.46 percent lower at 18,612.86. Its June futures fell 70 points to 18,630.
"Position-squaring by dealers ahead of the weekend started early in the afternoon, denting the Nikkei average," said Masaki Motohashi, general manager at Yamaichi Securities.
